items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But he did some very innovative things in the early days, with Baby Cox... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: but I suppose Duke thought that all he wanted a vocalist to do was sing one or two songs or three or four songs a night. And they didn't have to be Ella Fitzgerald or Sarah Vaughan to sing these songs, because the people that were hearing songs, some of them for the first time, and they probably wouldn't hear them again till the next time they heard Duke's band. And the people who recorded with Duke, if you listen to records, you'll see that Duke recorded them very well. Plus the arrangements that were around…
But he did some very innovative things in the early days, with Baby Cox, when he had her growling and smiling, you know.
